<!-- Generated by scripts/support_codes.py from support-codes.json. Do not edit. -->

The game did not show a window within 90 seconds.

## What happened

Possible causes:

- Other large downloads or first-run macOS work were still running.
- The game files are missing or damaged.

## What you can do

1. Wait until other large downloads and first-run macOS work finish.
2. If the game window is visible and only the sign-in or Notices window is blank, see [Sign-in or Notices stay blank](../troubleshooting.md#sign-in-or-notices-stay-blank).

Select **Retry** after you finish these steps. Retry repeats the failed operation. It keeps valid downloads and game files.

If the steps do not help, select **Repair**. Repair checks the installed game files and asks you to confirm before it changes them.

## Report the problem

Choose **Help → Report a Problem…** if these steps do not solve the problem. The report adds the code, the launcher version, and your Mac details.

In the report, say whether this was the first launch after an update and whether a second attempt differed.

A maintainer can ask for a diagnostics file. Then choose **Help → Save Diagnostics…**
